scene_zh: 一份成年人手机使用时长样本（模拟数据）

views.subject: Daily screen time
views.subtitle_en: Average daily screen time for a sample of adults.

examples.en: Daily screen time hit its lowest point in February, at 5.0 hours.
examples.zh: 日均屏幕时间在 2 月降到最低，为 5.0 小时。

features.note_zh: hit its lowest point in + 月份；数值前用 at。
features.interpret_zh: 2 月和 5 月并列 5.0 小时，说“2 月最低”只在取整后成立，严谨说法是并列最低。

examples.en: Screen time leveled off at about 5.1 hours from March to May.
examples.zh: 3 月到 5 月，屏幕时间在 5.1 小时左右走平。

features.note_zh: level off at + 数值；about 表示取整后的近似值。
features.interpret_zh: 平台期只有两个月，说“长期稳定”就过头了。

examples.en: Screen time climbed steadily from 5.3 hours in June to 6.2 hours in August.
examples.zh: 屏幕时间从 6 月的 5.3 小时稳步升到 8 月的 6.2 小时。

features.note_zh: climb steadily 适合连续多个区间上升；这里两段涨幅都在缩小。
features.interpret_zh: 三个月涨了 0.9 小时，可能与假期有关，但图里没有假期数据，只能描述走势。

examples.en: Screen time peaked in August, at 6.2 hours.
examples.zh: 屏幕时间在 8 月达到峰值 6.2 小时。

features.note_zh: peak 作动词，后接 in + 月份、at + 数值。
features.interpret_zh: 八月是样本里的最高月，不代表某个人的长期习惯。

examples.en: Screen time rose again in December, reaching 6.0 hours.
examples.zh: 屏幕时间在 12 月再次上升，达到 6.0 小时。

features.note_zh: rose again 表示下降后重新上升；reaching 引出终点值。
features.interpret_zh: 十二月回升但仍低于八月，不能算创出新高。

views.overview_zh: 全年在 5.0 到 6.2 小时之间波动：2 月和 5 月最低，夏季升高，8 月 6.2 小时见顶，秋季回落后 12 月又回到 6.0 小时。月度均值看不出时间花在哪类应用上。

general.a2: Daily screen time was about 5 hours for most of the year. It rose in the summer and was highest in August, at 6.2 hours. After a small drop in the fall, it rose again to 6.0 hours in December.
general.b1: Screen time stayed close to 5 hours from January to June, then climbed to a peak of 6.2 hours in August. It fell back to 5.3 hours by November before rising to 6.0 hours in December. The range across the year was only 1.2 hours.
general.b2: The series is remarkably stable for most of the year, moving between 5.0 and 5.3 hours from February to June. Summer breaks the pattern: values rose to 6.2 hours in August, then eased back over the autumn. December's return to 6.0 hours suggests a second high period, but the chart covers only one year, so seasonality cannot be confirmed.

descriptions.ielts: Daily screen time ranged from a low of 5.0 hours in February and May to a peak of 6.2 hours in August. It remained close to 5 hours in the first half of the year, rose during the summer, and finished at 6.0 hours in December.
descriptions.business: Screen time is stable at around five hours a day for most of the year, with a summer peak of 6.2 hours in August and a December rebound to 6.0. The swings are modest — 1.2 hours between the lowest and highest months — so any product or wellness initiative should focus on which apps take the time, not just the total.

views.subject: Screen time by app type
views.subtitle_en: Average daily minutes by app type.

examples.en: Short videos take up 96 minutes a day, nearly double the next category.
examples.zh: 短视频每天占用 96 分钟，接近第二名的两倍。

features.note_zh: take up + 时间 描述占用时长；nearly double 比 almost twice 更书面。
features.interpret_zh: 96 分钟是这八类的总和口径，不代表所有手机使用都在短视频上。

examples.en: Messaging ranks second, at 52 minutes a day.
examples.zh: 通讯排第二，每天 52 分钟。

features.interpret_zh: 通讯类排第二，但这类时长常和办事重叠，不一定都是娱乐。

examples.en: Social feed and video streaming are close: 44 versus 38 minutes a day.
examples.zh: 社交动态和视频播放很接近：每天 44 对 38 分钟。

features.note_zh: versus 并排两个数值；close 说明差距小。
features.interpret_zh: 6 分钟的差距在日常波动范围内，不宜说社交明显多于视频。

features.note_zh: 单项用 take 或 account for；这里 take 更口语。
features.interpret_zh: 购物时长不高，但下单金额可能集中在很短时段，图里看不出来。

examples.en: Email has the lowest figure, at 8 minutes a day.
examples.zh: 邮件最低，每天 8 分钟。

features.note_zh: the lowest figure；描述类别时也可说 the smallest block。
features.interpret_zh: 最低只说明时长，不说明重要性——工作邮件可能主要在电脑上处理。

views.overview_zh: 八类应用合计 300 分钟。短视频 96 分钟遥遥领先，接近第二名通讯的两倍；短视频、通讯、社交动态三类合计 192 分钟，接近总时长的三分之二。其余五类都低于 40 分钟。这张图只给时长，不给使用场景或打开次数。

general.a2: Short videos take the most time, at 96 minutes a day. Messaging is second with 52 minutes, and social feed is third with 44. Email uses the least time, at 8 minutes.
general.b1: Short videos dominate at 96 minutes a day, nearly twice the 52 minutes spent on messaging. Social feed and video streaming follow at 44 and 38 minutes, while email and maps take less than 15 minutes each.
general.b2: The time budget is concentrated at the top: short videos take 96 minutes a day and messaging 52, so the two largest categories account for just under half of the 300 minutes across all eight. Activity falls away quickly after that, with shopping, games, maps and email together contributing 70 minutes.

descriptions.ielts: Short videos accounted for the largest share of screen time at 96 minutes a day, followed by messaging at 52 minutes and social feed at 44. Email recorded the smallest figure at 8 minutes, while shopping, games and maps each took between 14 and 26 minutes.
descriptions.business: Short videos occupy 96 minutes a day, nearly double messaging at 52 and almost a third of the 300 minutes measured across the eight categories. The long tail — shopping, games, maps and email — adds up to only 70 minutes. If the goal is to reduce total screen time, short video is the only category big enough to move the number.
